summary: Sprint 5 (J-3) affiliate program e2e — backend + frontend smoke. Built /app/backend/tests/test_sprint5_affiliate_e2e.py covering onboarding (invite→magic-link join, auto-generated coupon code, collision suffix), bulk CSV invite (5 columns with per-row status), alias rotation on discount change, referral cookie, payout settings (USDT/USDC ERC-20 validation, disallowed currencies), payout runs history, mark-paid flow, and demo affiliate dashboard. Result: 13 passed / 1 skipped / 3 xfail out of 17 (0 failures). Frontend smoke: demo affiliate login + /affiliate dashboard render — Diamond tier, overview/performance/payments/compliance/settings tabs, 21 clicks tracked, KPIs visible. 5 spec-vs-impl gaps surfaced (xfail/documented).

minor.issue: Invalid ref code returns silent 200 {ok:true} instead of 404 per Sprint 5 spec. Current impl calls affiliate_capture_click() which no-ops on unknown code without raising HTTPException. Impact: analytics pollution, breaks intent-signal detection. FIX: in affiliate_capture_click, if no affiliate row matches the code, raise HTTPException(404). Priority P2 (non-blocking for launch but wrong contract).

Endpoint has no `dry_run` parameter (signature: admin, period only). Sprint 5 spec asks for `dry_run=true` → preview mode with no external call. Current impl always creates real payout rows and marks referrals. Since NOWPayments Mass Payouts is a separate step (batch endpoint), this doesn't send crypto — but referrals get payout_id assigned irreversibly. FIX: add `dry_run: bool = False` and short-circuit before insert_one when true (return the computed groups + FX). Priority P1 (test/audit workflow blocker).

USDT TRC20 addresses (34 chars starting with 'T') are rejected — _normalize_payout only accepts Ethereum EIP-55 (0x + 40 hex). Sprint 5 spec explicitly lists TRC20 as an allowed network for USDT. Impact: affiliates paid on Tron (lower fees) can't configure. FIX: extend validation to accept TRC20 base58 (starts with T, 34 chars) when currency=usdt OR usdc; store `payout_network` alongside address so batch payout picks the right NOWPayments currency (usdttrc20 / usdterc20). Priority P1.

Impl sets status='paid'; spec says 'paid_manual' to distinguish from auto/NOWPayments-confirmed. Ambiguity in ledger — hard to reconcile manual USDT sends vs automated batch. Also affiliate.commissions.paid/pending buckets not verified in this run (no ready payout available to mark). Priority P2.

FX rate CAD→USD is fetched by _fetch_cad_to_usd_rate() and stored per payout, but NOT surfaced on the affiliate dashboard response. Spec asks for transparent display to user. FIX: include {"fx_rate_cad_to_usd":..., "fx_source":..., "fx_captured_at":...} in _affiliate_public() so the Payments tab can show 'CAD 100 = USD X.YY (Banque du Canada, timestamp)'. Priority P2.

issues: CSP violations persist for Cloudflare beacon (static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js) + 2 inline scripts injected by Emergent preview harness — same as iter 26. Console noise only; not functional. Prod-facing CSP is `script-src 'self'`; add explicit script-src for the beacon origin or accept the noise in preview.

action_items: P1 — /payouts/run: add dry_run param to support the preview workflow the ops team needs before hitting NOWPayments.
P1 — Payout config: accept USDT/USDC TRC20 addresses (base58, 34 chars, prefix 'T') and persist payout_network so the batch endpoint routes usdttrc20 correctly.
P2 — /api/affiliate/ref/{code}: return 404 on unknown code (currently silent 200 causing analytics noise and breaking the spec-defined contract).
P2 — mark-paid: change status to 'paid_manual' (or add a separate `paid_via` field) so manual USDT sends are distinguishable from NOWPayments-confirmed paid.
P2 — Surface fx_rate_cad_to_usd + fx_source + fx_captured_at in /api/affiliate/me so the dashboard can display CAD→USD conversion transparently.

P3 — Not covered in this iteration (needs full checkout+webhook harness to reproduce): commission math on paid order (5% × subtotal → pending), cancel → reversed, self-purchase anti-fraud flag. Recommend a dedicated test file `test_affiliate_commission_math.py` with a seeded order + a mocked payment webhook next iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:9342 _normalize_payout — hard-coded to ERC-20 Ethereum only. TRC20 is universally supported by USDT (and cheaper) — omitting it is a launch-day feature gap for a peptide vertical whose affiliate base is likely to hold USDT on Tron.

server.py:11310 admin_affiliate_run_payouts — no dry_run branch. Also NOT idempotent on partial failure: on DuplicateKeyError it 'recovers' the referral→payout link but silently drops the group total. Consider returning a per-group report with skipped/recovered/failed counts.

server.py:11840 admin_affiliate_mark_paid — updates status='paid' but doesn't touch the affiliate.commissions.{pending,paid} counters directly (relies on downstream aggregation). Verify that /api/affiliate/me metrics recompute from affiliate_referrals.status='paid' — if there's any denormalized pending counter, it'll drift.
server.py:10518 affiliate_ref — silently swallows unknown codes (no raise, returns {ok:true}). Bug per spec + hides typo'd affiliate URLs in analytics.

routers/affiliate.py + server.py — 180+ affiliate functions all live in server.py (13,461 lines total). Sprint 5 is a good time to split affiliate helpers (_apply_affiliate_to_order, affiliate_on_order_reversed, _generate_affiliate_coupon, _rotate_affiliate_coupon, all admin/list handlers) into `backend/affiliate_service.py` — routers/affiliate.py already exists as the thin FastAPI layer. Would drop server.py by ~2000 lines and let tests import service functions directly.

rca_of_the_issue: Not a single-bug iteration — surfaced 5 spec-vs-impl gaps across payout config (TRC20 unsupported), payout run (no dry_run), mark-paid (wrong status enum), ref endpoint (silent 200 on invalid code), and dashboard FX transparency. Root cause across the set: the Sprint 5 spec was written assuming multi-network payout + explicit preview + granular status enum, but the impl evolved from Sprint 3 with ERC-20-only + implicit run-and-commit + boolean paid. Recommend main agent take an alignment pass on affiliate spec.md vs implementation before launch (J-3).
